name: @lntt/scope
description: The host-agnostic scope runtime for @lntt/wire: a scope (a carrier, its channels, a guard/leaf stack) run as a typed fold. Framework-free — the host integrations live in @lntt/integration. Carriers and channels ship as tree-shakable subpaths, each owning the ctx entries it populates and the outcome vocabulary it coins (./http, ./trpc, ./react-router, ./body, ./query, ./request-cookies, ./request-headers, ./cookies, ./headers) — validation among them (./standard-schema).
